name: image-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Issues presigned S3 PutObject/GetObject URLs for uploading and viewing images, and holds the AWS credentials — never exposed to the browser.

description: Owns image metadata (owner, S3 object key, filename, content type, size, upload time) in image-db, and issues short-lived S3 presigned URLs for upload and view so image bytes never pass through this service. Enforces that a caller only ever lists or reads their own images, keyed off the Thunder-signed caller identity. Does not store or proxy image bytes itself.
